name: DuPont Styrofoam Panel Core 20 (XPS foam board)
note: Typical values: density 1.5 lb/ft3 (24 kg/m3, ASTM D1622), flexural modulus 1,600 psi (11,000 kPa, ASTM C203), shear modulus 330 psi (2,275 kPa, ASTM C273). XPS is the classic DIY panel-speaker material. The flexural modulus includes the foam's own shear, so a thin XPS panel reads a little soft.
